phaseModel.multiSegment: first segment = departure; last segment = arrival; strictly intermediate segments = body
phaseModel.departurePath: source node branch path, plus a semantic yes/no token only when the edge directly leaves the focus real fork
phaseModel.directSingleSegment: compare departure and arrival membership at the focus fork; disagreement is unresolved
phaseModel.directAgreementScope: same membership status and immediate side at the focus fork; exact full-path agreement is also reported
